headline: Oura PULLS 🪢 $15bn 📈 STOCK 💰 Listing 🧾 DAYS ⏰ After 📣 Announcement 📢
text:
Oura 🏷️ just YEETED 🗑️ its MASSIVE 🍆 $15bn 💰 stock 📈 market 🏬 listing 🧾 plan 📜 a mere 🕒 few 📅 days 🗓️ after 🚀 announcing 📣 it 🫵 bro 🧔 the wearable ⌚ tech 🛠️ company 🏭 that makes 🛠️ those slick 🥋 smart 💍 rings 💍 which track 🧭 your ❤️ heartbeat 💓 and 😴 sleep 🛌 patterns 📊 decided 🙋 to postpone ⏳ its flotation 🛟 due 😩 to UNCERTAINTY ❓ in the Initial 🆕 Public 📣 Offering 💸 IPO 🏛️ market 🛒 and 🤝 didn't even 🚫 drop 📉 a hint 🕵️ on when 🕰️ it might 🍆 go 💨 ahead 🏁!! Chief 🧑‍💼 executive 🧑‍💼 Tom 🍆 Hale 🧔 who rocks 🪨 one 1️⃣ of the company's own 💍 smart 💍 rings 💍 on his finger 🖐️ basically edged ⏳ the whole 📈 situation 🌀 saying 📢 an IPO 🏛️ is just one 1️⃣ step 🦶 in our journey 🛤️ we have the luxury 🛍️ of choosing ⏰ our moment ⏳ while the tech 🛠️ firm 🏭 becomes the latest 🆕 business 🏬 to delay ⏳ its public 📣 listing 🧾 experts 🧠 claiming the IPO 🏛️ market 🛒 is getting more challenging 🥊!!

Oura 🏷️ had filed 📁 official 📜 documents 📑 setting 📐 out plans 📍 to raise 🙌 up to $2.2bn 💰 by offering 🛍️ shares 📈 in the business 🏭 to investors 💼 just over 🔄 a week 📆 ago 🕒 and now the maker 🛠️ of those health 🩺 tracking 💍 rings 💍 is cooked 🍳 by the current 🌡️ IPO 🏛️ climate 🥶 Tom 🍆 Hale 🧔 our favorite ring daddy 💍 keeps insisting 📢 they can pick ⏰ their own timing ⏰ like a true tease 😏 while US nuclear ☢️ firm Holtec ☢️ also postponed ⏳ its own flotation 🛟 citing an unusual confluence 🌊 of developments 🧩 that impaired investor 💼 confidence 😬 in the market 🛒 for new 🆕 public 📣 offerings 💸!! Rising energy ⚡ costs 💰 military conflicts ⚔️ global trade tensions 🤝 and inflation worries 😟 have led central banks 🏦 including the US Federal Reserve 🏛️ to hike 📈 benchmark interest rates 📊 this week 📆 the yield 📈 on US debt 💸 repayable in 10 🔟 years 🗓️ hit the highest level 🏔️ since 2007 📅 Samuel Kerr 🧔 global head 🧠 of equity capital markets 🏬 at Mergermarket 📊 straight up admitted 📢 what is now clear 🔎 is we are in a very different IPO 🏛️ market 🛒 to the one we envisaged just a few weeks 🗓️ ago 🕒!!

The company 🏭 planned 📍 to sell 🛍️ shares 📈 priced at between $40 💵 and $44 💵 on the Nasdaq 🖥️ stock market index 📊 giving the whole operation 🏭 an implied market value 💰 of $15bn 🤑 in its last full financial year 📅 ending 30 September 2025 🗓️ Oura 🏷️ made a pre-tax profit 📈 of $23.5m 💰 on sales 🛒 of $907.8m 💰 that compares 📊 to a $6.2m 💰 pre-tax profit 📈 in the previous year 📆 its most recent figures 📊 for the nine months 📅 to 30 June 🗓️ this year show pre-tax income 📈 of $70m 💰 on sales 🛒 of $1.2bn 💰 the Finland 🇫🇮 founded 🏗️ 2013 🗓️ outfit with global headquarters 🏠 in San Francisco 🌉 pumps out smart 💍 rings 💍 costing upwards of $300 💵 that monitor 🧭 heartbeat ❤️ sleep 😴 movement 🏃 breathing 🫁 and temperature 🌡️ all analyzed 🧪 and presented 📱 on an app 📲!!

Oura 🏷️ is the subject 📑 of a class action lawsuit ⚖️ which accused 🫵 it of false advertising 📣 by claiming its rings 💍 can accurately track 🧭 a person's sleep 😴 activity 🏃 and patterns 📊 the lawsuit ⚖️ filed 📁 by the Clarkson Law Firm 🏛️ in August 🗓️ claimed 📢 Oura rings 💍 cannot measure 📏 one's sleep 😴 or cycles 🔄 that's because sleep 😴 happens in the brain 🧠 not on one's finger 🖐️ it is understood 🤝 that Oura's decision 🙋 to delay ⏳ an IPO 🏛️ is not connected 🔗 to the lawsuit ⚖️ in a statement 🗣️ a spokesperson 🗣️ for Oura 🏷️ said we stand 🧍 behind our science 🔬 research 📚 and accuracy claims 📏 they added 🗣️ like other consumer 🛍️ sleep 😴 wearables ⌚ Oura Ring 💍 estimates sleep 😴 stages 📊 using multiple physiological signals 📡 including heart rate ❤️ heart rate variability 📉 movement 🏃 breathing 🫁 patterns 📊 and temperature 🌡️!!

The whole saga 🌀 has everyone 🫂 wondering 🤔 if sleepmaxxing 😴 is secretly making your rest 🛌 worse 😩 or if your fitness tracker ⌚ can know you're pregnant 🤰 before you do 🫃 either way Tom 🍆 Hale 🧔 and his crew 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 are playing the long game 🕹️ with that luxury 🛍️ of choosing their moment ⏰ while the broader IPO 🏛️ market 🛒 keeps getting railed 💦 by rising yields 📈 inflation 😤 and geopolitical headaches 🤕 but don't worry 😌 Oura 🏷️ stands firm 🪨 behind its data 📊 and those little 💍 rings 💍 that track your every 😴 twitch 🧘‍♂️
